### 2.3 — The ACARS frame (~2 slides)

#### Slide: ACARS frame anatomy

Every datalink message — whether over classic VHF or VDL2 AVLC (`FF FF 01` prefix) —
shares this fundamental frame structure:

```
DEL  [mode 1B]  [reg 7B]  [ack 1B]  [label 2B]  [block_id 1B]
     STX  [downlink header 10B ← air→ground only]  [text]  ETX/ETB  [CRC 2B]
```

| Field | Size | Content |
|-------|------|---------|
| `mode` | 1 B | message format identifier |
| `reg` | 7 B | aircraft registration, e.g. `G-EZBJ ` |
| `ack` | 1 B | `ACK` (0x06) positive / `NAK` (0x15) negative |
| `label` | 2 B | **content router** — determines which application decoder runs |
| `block_id` | 1 B | `A–G` = air→ground; `Q–Z` = ground→air; carries sequence number |
| downlink header | 10 B | msg_number (3B) + msg_sequence (1B) + flight_id (6B); air→ground only |
| `text` | var | free text *or* ARINC 622 envelope |
| delimiter | 1 B | `ETX` = last/only block; `ETB` = more blocks follow |

All parsed in `crates/acars/src/decode/acars.rs` → `AcarsMessage`.

#### Slide: The label as application router

The 2-byte label determines which decoder in `AcarsAppPayload` runs:

| Label | Application | Module |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| `H1` / `T1` | ARINC 622 envelope (CPDLC, ADS-C) or OHMA | `payload/arinc622/` or `payload/boeing/` |
| `B9` | ATIS request (ARINC 623 TI2) | `payload/arinc623/atis.rs` |
| `A9` | ATIS delivery | `payload/arinc623/atis.rs` |
| `A0` / `B0` | AFN contact/logon | `payload/arinc622/afn.rs` |
| `B1` | Oceanic clearance OC1 | `payload/arinc622/oceanic.rs` |
| `QF` / `QQ` | OOOI events | `payload/aoc/oooi.rs` |
| `80` | AOC position/event report | `payload/aoc/label80.rs` |
| `5Z` | AOC slash-fields | `payload/aoc/label5z.rs` |
| `SA` | Media Advisory (link state) | `payload/arinc620/media_advisory.rs` |
| `MA` | MIAM file transfer | `payload/miam.rs` |
| `Q0` | Link test / heartbeat | *(empty payload)* |

All routes wired in `crates/acars/src/decode/payload/mod.rs` → `AcarsAppPayload` enum.

### 2.4 — ARINC 622: the application envelope (~2 slides)

#### Slide: ARINC 622 envelope structure

When `label = H1` and the text starts with `/`, it is an **ARINC 622 envelope** —
a structured addressing layer embedded in the ACARS text field:

```
/  ATSU_ADDR  .  IMI  .  REG  payload  CRC
```

| Part | Example | Meaning |
|------|---------|---------|
| `/` | `/` | envelope marker |
| `ATSU_ADDR` | `CZQX` / `EGGX` / `KZWY` | ATSU address (ground station/facility) |
| `.IMI.` | `.ADS.` / `.AT1.` | Interline Message Identifier — application router |
| `REG` | `G-EZBJ` / `A7-ANR` | aircraft registration |
| `payload` | binary | application data (encoding depends on IMI) |
| `CRC` | 2 B | frame integrity check |

Parsed by `crates/acars/src/decode/payload/arinc622/mod.rs` →
`RawMessage` (deku) → `Message { atsu_address, imi, registration, payload }`.

#### Slide: IMI — routing to the application

The 3-character IMI selects the payload decoder (`Imi` enum → `Payload` enum):

| IMI | Application | Payload encoding |
|-----|-------------|------------------|
| `ADS` | ADS-C position report or contract uplink | TLV (tag-length-value, 18 tag types) |
| `AT1` | FANS-1/A CPDLC message body | UPER (handwritten bit-level decoder) |
| `CR1` | CPDLC connect request | UPER + optional embedded uplink message |
| `CC1` | CPDLC connect confirm | UPER |
| `DR1` | CPDLC disconnect request | short UPER / CRC-only |
| `AB1` | AOC message | raw hex preserved |
| `DIS` | ADS-C disconnect | short control |

ATSU addresses encode the **facility identity**:
`CZQX` = Gander Oceanic, `EGGX` = Shanwick, `KZWY` = New York Oceanic,
`BDOCAYA` = ARINC VDL2 ground network.
